# Deep Vortex AI Image Upscaler

> Upscale images up to 4x with AI — restore detail, enhance clarity, and enlarge without quality loss.

## URL

https://upscaler.deepvortexai.com

## About

The Deep Vortex AI Image Upscaler uses AI-powered super-resolution technology to enlarge images by 2x or 4x while enhancing detail, sharpness, and overall clarity. Unlike traditional upscaling methods that produce blurry or pixelated results, the AI analyzes and reconstructs image detail at the pixel level — producing output that looks genuinely sharper and more detailed than the original.

Upload any JPG, PNG, or WEBP image, select your upscaling factor, and receive a high-resolution enhanced version in seconds. A before/after preview lets you compare the original and upscaled versions side by side. Whether you are restoring an old photograph, preparing an image for large-format print, or enhancing a small product photo for e-commerce, the AI Upscaler delivers results that would otherwise require expensive software or manual retouching.

Credits are shared with your Deep Vortex AI account and work across all tools. New accounts get 2 free credits to try it right away.

## FAQ

Q: What is the difference between 2x and 4x upscaling?
A: The 2x option doubles the width and height of your image, resulting in a version with four times the total pixel count. The 4x option quadruples the width and height, resulting in sixteen times the total pixel count. Use 2x for moderate enlargements and 4x for maximum resolution enhancement, such as preparing images for large-format print.

Q: Does AI upscaling actually improve image quality, or does it just make the file bigger?
A: AI upscaling genuinely reconstructs and enhances image detail rather than simply stretching pixels. The model analyzes patterns and textures in the original image and generates realistic detail at the higher resolution — producing results that are sharper and more detailed than conventional interpolation methods would achieve.

Q: What image formats are supported?
A: The tool accepts JPG, PNG, and WEBP input formats. The output is delivered as a high-resolution image ready for immediate download.

Q: Can I see a comparison before downloading?
A: Yes. The tool provides a side-by-side before/after preview so you can inspect the quality of the upscaled image before committing to a download.

Q: How much does one upscale cost?
A: Each image upscale costs 1 credit from your shared Deep Vortex AI wallet. The same credits can be used across all tools in the ecosystem — image generation, background removal, 3D modeling, voice synthesis, and more.

Q: What is the maximum input image size?
A: The tool processes standard image files up to reasonable file size limits. For very large images, 4x upscaling will produce extremely large output files — for most use cases, 2x upscaling on a good-quality original produces excellent results. If you encounter issues with very large files, try 2x upscaling first.

Q: Is the upscaled image suitable for professional print production?
A: Yes. The AI-enhanced output is suitable for professional use cases including large-format printing, editorial publishing, and commercial product photography. Output quality depends on the quality of the original image — a reasonably sharp original at moderate resolution will produce excellent high-resolution output after 4x upscaling.
